description: The signed-in account and the organization the call acts in: email and profile, the organization (id, slug, name, personal or shared) and the caller's role in it (viewer, member, admin or owner), how the call is authenticated (api_key, oauth or session), the organization's plan in force (status, renewal date, set to cancel or not), this month's use of every limit (units used and remaining, described areas remaining, API keys, requests a minute, when units reset), and what the next plan adds with its checkout_url. Plan, usage and limits belong to the organization and are shared by its members and keys. Free. Call it before a large batch to check it fits, and after a human pays to see the new plan. Needs an API key or a connected account.
name: get_account
title: Get account
